answer: A willow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the canyon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the haven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a systems thinking, emergent properties highlighted register, it stays short. The design leans on automated market makers with concentrated liquidity. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
